mapper.insert: insert into material_stock_allocation (allocation_no, material_id, request_stock_id, request_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, status, retry_count, fail_reason, reason, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{allocationNo}, #{materialId}, #{requestStockId}, #{requestQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{outboundQty}, #{releasedQty}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{failReason}, #{reason}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, allocation_no, material_id, request_stock_id, request_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, status, retry_count, fail_reason, reason, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock_allocation where id = #{id} and is_del = 0

select id, allocation_no, material_id, request_stock_id, request_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, status, retry_count, fail_reason, reason, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock_allocation where allocation_no = #{allocationNo} and is_del = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update material_stock_allocation set locked_qty = #{allocation.lockedQty}, outbound_qty = #{allocation.outboundQty}, released_qty = #{allocation.releasedQty}, status = #{allocation.status}, retry_count = #{allocation.retryCount}, fail_reason = #{allocation.failReason}, reason = #{allocation.reason}, update_time = #{allocation.updateTime} where id = #{allocation.id} and status = #{expectedStatus} and is_del = 0

update material_stock_allocation set retry_count = retry_count + 1, fail_reason = #{failReason}, status = case when retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} then 5 else status end, update_time = now() where allocation_no = #{allocationNo} and status = 0 and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select id, allocation_no, material_id, request_stock_id, request_qty, locked_qty, outbound_qty, released_qty, status, retry_count, fail_reason, reason, is_del, create_time, update_time from material_stock_allocation where status = #{status} and is_del = 0 order by create_time asc, id asc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
